    //==
    // # Metaball influence and summation
    //
    // Summed radial falloff kernels over the metaball types declared in
    // `implicit-sdf.types.plato`. The system's field value is the total
    // influence minus the threshold, so its zero level set is the blob boundary
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metaballs).

    // The influence of one planar ball at a point: Strength at the centre, falling
    // smoothly to zero at Radius and staying zero beyond it.
    InfluenceAt(self: MetaBall2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Strength * MetaBallFalloff(self.Center.Between(point).Magnitude / self.Radius);

    // The influence of one spatial ball at a point; negative strengths carve.
    InfluenceAt(self: MetaBall3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Strength * MetaBallFalloff(self.Center.Between(point).Magnitude / self.Radius);

    // The radial falloff kernel as a function of distance measured in radii: one
    // at the centre, zero at and beyond one radius, with vanishing first and
    // second derivatives at both ends. The classic Wyvill cubic (1 - r^2)^3.
    MetaBallFalloff(normalizedDistance: Number): Number
        => (1.0 - normalizedDistance * normalizedDistance).Saturate.Cube;

    // The blob field value: the summed influence of every ball, less Threshold.
    // Negative outside the blob, zero on its outline, positive inside — note this
    // is the OPPOSITE sign convention to a signed distance field.
    Eval(self: MetaBallSystem2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Balls.Reduce(0.0, (total, ball) => total + ball.InfluenceAt(point)) - self.Threshold;

    // The blob field value: the summed influence of every ball, less Threshold.
    Eval(self: MetaBallSystem3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Balls.Reduce(0.0, (total, ball) => total + ball.InfluenceAt(point)) - self.Threshold;

    //==
    // # Flat node tree and graph accessors
    //
    // Root-node lookup and index ordering for the flat, index-based structures:
    // the SDF combination trees of `implicit-sdf.types.plato` and the scalar field
    // expression graphs of `fields.types.plato`. The recursive evaluators live in
    // `implicit-sdf.library.plato` and `fields-graphs.library.plato`; these
    // name the entry point and the index ordering a walker relies on.

    //==
    // # SDF combination trees

    // The node producing the tree's final distance.
    RootNode(self: SdfTree2D): SdfNode2D
        => self.Nodes[self.Root.Value];

    // The node producing the tree's final distance.
    RootNode(self: SdfTree3D): SdfNode3D
        => self.Nodes[self.Root.Value];

    // SdfNodeIndex implements IIndex, so its ordering and hash are the derived
    // IIndex bodies in `collections.library.plato`: node indices order by
    // position in the node array, which is already a valid evaluation order.

    //==
    // # IField expression graphs
    //
    // The same flat-graph shape over scalar fields.

    // The node producing the graph's result.
    RootNode(self: ScalarFieldGraph2D): ScalarFieldNode2D
        => self.Nodes[self.Root.Value];

    // The node producing the graph's result.
    RootNode(self: ScalarFieldGraph3D): ScalarFieldNode3D
        => self.Nodes[self.Root.Value];

    // FieldNodeIndex likewise implements IIndex, so its ordering and hash come
    // from the derived IIndex bodies.

    //==
    // # Sampled signed distance field lattice geometry
    //
    // Node counts and node spacing for the discretized SDFs of
    // `implicit-sdf.types.plato`. The interpolating evaluators live in
    // `implicit-sdf.library.plato` (they need local bindings for the
    // per-axis fractional weights); the lattice geometry below is what they and any
    // resampler are written against.

    // The number of lattice nodes along each axis. Both axes include their
    // endpoints, so a node count of n spans n - 1 cells.
    NodeCounts(self: SampledSdf2D): IntegerVector2
        => (self.Values.ColumnCount, self.Values.RowCount);

    // The number of lattice nodes along each axis.
    NodeCounts(self: SampledSdf3D): IntegerVector3
        => (self.Values.ColumnCount, self.Values.RowCount, self.Values.LayerCount);

    // The spacing between adjacent lattice nodes along each axis: the sampling
    // resolution, and the scale of the interpolation error.
    NodeSpacing(self: SampledSdf2D): Vector2D
        => (
            (self.Bounds.Max.X - self.Bounds.Min.X) / (self.Values.ColumnCount - 1).ToNumber,
            (self.Bounds.Max.Y - self.Bounds.Min.Y) / (self.Values.RowCount - 1).ToNumber);

    // The spacing between adjacent lattice nodes along each axis.
    NodeSpacing(self: SampledSdf3D): Vector3D
        => (
            (self.Bounds.Max.X - self.Bounds.Min.X) / (self.Values.ColumnCount - 1).ToNumber,
            (self.Bounds.Max.Y - self.Bounds.Min.Y) / (self.Values.RowCount - 1).ToNumber,
            (self.Bounds.Max.Z - self.Bounds.Min.Z) / (self.Values.LayerCount - 1).ToNumber);

    //==
    // # Function-valued implicit shape algebra
    //
    // Bodies for the stored-function implicit shapes of
    // `implicit-sdf.types.plato`: evaluation, the lifts from any SDF interface
    // implementor, and the CSG algebra closed over each form — SDF booleans are
    // min/max on the stored distance, region booleans are the Boolean connectives
    // on the stored predicate.
    //
    // Every SDF operator here defers to the matching `*Distance` kernel in
    // `implicit-sdf.library.plato` and inherits the fidelity claim stated there —
    // exact, a lower bound, or not a bound (`implicit-sdf.concepts.plato`). A
    // region or volume operator carries no distance and so no such claim.

    // The stored distance function applied to the position.
    Eval(self: FunctionSdf2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Function(point);

    // The stored distance function applied to the position.
    Eval(self: FunctionSdf3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Function(point);

    // The stored membership predicate applied to the position.
    Eval(self: FunctionRegion2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => self.Function(point);

    // The stored membership predicate applied to the position.
    Eval(self: FunctionVolume3D, point: Point3D): Boolean
        => self.Function(point);

    // Any planar SDF as a function-valued one, so the combinators below apply to
    // every implementor. Implicit: the same distance at every point
    // (Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Conversions).
    FunctionSdf2D(self: ISignedDistanceField2D): FunctionSdf2D
        => FunctionSdf2D(p => self.Eval(p));

    // Any spatial SDF as a function-valued one. Implicit, for the same reason.
    FunctionSdf3D(self: ISignedDistanceField3D): FunctionSdf3D
        => FunctionSdf3D(p => self.Eval(p));

    // The region a planar SDF induces: inside is where the distance is negative.
    // Discards the distance, keeping only membership — and `< 0.0` also excludes
    // the zero level set — so this stays an explicit ToX, never a conversion.
    ToRegion(self: ISignedDistanceField2D): FunctionRegion2D
        => FunctionRegion2D(p => self.Eval(p) < 0.0);

    // The volume a spatial SDF induces: inside is where the distance is negative.
    ToVolume(self: ISignedDistanceField3D): FunctionVolume3D
        => FunctionVolume3D(p => self.Eval(p) < 0.0);

    // The union of two planar SDFs: the pointwise minimum distance. Exact.
    Union(a: FunctionSdf2D, b: FunctionSdf2D): FunctionSdf2D
        => FunctionSdf2D(p => a.Eval(p).Min(b.Eval(p)));
